subject: Fix raxRemove crash at memcpy() due to key size exceeds max Rax size (#1722)
reason: The fix adds a size-limit guard (comprsize + h->size > RAX_NODE_MAX_SIZE, ~512MB) to the recompression populate-loop in raxRemove(), preventing a heap-overflow memcpy that crashes only when a single rax key spans a compressible chain exceeding RAX_NODE_MAX_SIZE. All command-reachable rax tables with user-controlled key lengths (stream group/consumer names, ACL usernames, client-tracking prefixes/keys) would each require one command argument larger than ~512MB to reach this path, since recompression merges only the unique suffix of a single remaining key and many small shared-prefix keys cannot
